title: Binance Futures Will List USDⓈ-M BTC & ETH Quarterly 0624 Futures Contracts
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will list USDⓈ-M BTC and ETH Quarterly 0624 Contracts at 2022-03-22 03:30 AM (UTC). USDⓈ-M Quarterly 0325 Contracts will expire and settle at 2022-03-25 08:00 AM (UTC). Notes: Users are only allowed to close their positions or place Reduce Only orders, and are not allowed to open any new positions 10 minutes prior to delivery. For further information, please refer to  Delivery and Settlement of Quarterly Futures .  Risk Warning : Futures trading carries substantial risk and the possibility of both significant profits and losses. Past gains are not indicative of future returns. All of your margin balance may be liquidated in the event of extreme price movements.
